python3 -B -c 'from pathlib import Path
p = Path("/etc/systemd/network/10-kv260-win11-direct.network")
content = "[Match]\nName=eth0\n\n[Network]\nAddress=192.168.50.2/24\nDHCP=no\n"
if p.exists():
    if p.read_text() != content:
        raise SystemExit("Existing configuration differs; refusing to overwrite")
    print("CONFIG_ALREADY_MATCHES", p)
else:
    with p.open("x") as f:
        f.write(content)
    print("CONFIG_CREATED", p)
' && networkctl reload && networkctl reconfigure eth0 && sleep 3 && ip -4 addr show eth0 && ip -4 route && cat /etc/systemd/network/10-kv260-win11-direct.network && sha256sum /etc/systemd/network/10-kv260-win11-direct.network
